scope: Seven original organ membrane gates only, six simultaneous mixed-radius cells per gate, opposite-side exchange and return, using explicit organ-layers tissue-wall contract; not whole-body crowd acceptance
limitations: Placement samples legal fixed neighborhoods of original gates; it does not move gates or vessel points.
Actual P.update(s,500,.003) budget; options/land query wrappers select each current job cell radius. Each scenario has a 30 CPU-second cap. Offline CPU time is not native frame evidence.
All six units share faction 1 and receive individual actual move commands; this tests bidirectional transit, not combat or formations.
Brain boundaries remain coarse locator; bone geometry is not added by this harness.

All failed starts, CPU budgets, simulation timeouts, overlaps and whole-frame displacement rejections are retained. A displacement rejection is not confirmed wall penetration: a frame can include multiple collision-slide substeps, while this independent check tests its straight endpoint chord with a larger sweep reserve.
